name: Personal-Customer-Relation-Management-PCRM
description: Mobile-first Personal CRM web app (React front-end) for managing contacts, interactions and locations — University of Melbourne COMP30022 IT Project, S2 2021.

paragraphs: A mobile-first personal CRM: contacts, geo-tagged meetings, a map, a calendar and QR-code contact exchange. Built by Team 4399 for COMP30022 IT Project (The University of Melbourne, 2021 Semester 2), revived in 2026 as a single Next.js app, then extended with insights that show their uncertainty, data rights, an activity log and an optional bring-your-own-key AI assistant.
features: | Landing page. What the project is, with a one-click guest sandbox and no sign-up. | Dark mode. Every page has a dark theme, which follows the system setting. | | Home dashboard. Up next, time to reconnect, and the…

| Contacts on a phone. Designed phone-first, like the 2021 app (390 px wide). | A meeting on a phone. Meeting detail with the map pin and notes. | Calendar on a phone. The month grid and the meetings of the selected…
Each recording is a narrated end-to-end run of one journey; the numbered steps are the captions shown on screen.
One click on “Try it as a guest” opens a private 24-hour sandbox. No sign-up.
Home: who you are meeting next and who is due a catch-up.
